verdict.rationale: The docs state that Slate automatically selects the right model for the job. For example, it plans with Claude, searches with GLM and executes with Codex without user intervention, and users can also override per-slot defaults via `/models` or `slate.json`. The claim comes only from brief first-party statements, with little detail on how selection works. Missing for 10: documentation of the selection logic and criteria, and independent or hands-on corroboration that automatic routing works as claimed.
